#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int n, m, s;
long long t;

void doStep() {
    int jump = (int)((t--) % n);
    s += (s < m ? 1 : -1) * jump;
    s %= n;
    if (s < 0) s += n;
}

void doCycle() {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) doStep();
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
    s--;
    
    while ((t % n) != 0) doStep();
    
    vector<long long> seen(n, -1);
    while (t != 0) {
        doCycle();
        if (seen[s] != -1) {
            long long period = seen[s] - t;
            t %= period;
            break;
        }
        seen[s] = t;
    }
    
    while (t != 0) doStep();
    cout << s + 1 << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
